Name: Applied Storage
Author: moyueranshang
Description:
[b]Applied Storage[/b]
[i]One pool instead of a hundred chests.[/i]
Everything you store ends up in a single shared pool that travels with your save, so you never have to remember which chest holds your coal. The terminal is a search box first: type a name (pinyin works), take what you need, and get back to farming.
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Unlimited shared pool.[/b] Stackable goods collapse into one number. Anything that carries state — preserves with their ingredient, dyed items, items other mods have attached data to — is kept as a complete instance and comes back exactly as it went in.[/*]
[*][b]Storage Controller.[/b] Place it anywhere; it anchors the network. Right-click to open the terminal.[/*]
[*][b]Terminal.[/b] Search by name or ID (pinyin for Chinese), eight tabs (All / Ore / Metal Bars / Materials / Edible / Decor / Seeds / Other), plus a colour picker.[/*]
[*][b]Crafting from storage.[/b] The vanilla crafting menu pulls whatever is missing straight from the pool.[/*]
[*][b]Storage Interface.[/b] Place it next to machines and it feeds them from the pool and collects their output. Works with vanilla machines and most modded ones, with a connection range of 1, 3 or 5 tiles.[/*]
[*][b]Magnet mode[/b] [i](new in 0.2.3)[/i]. Switch it on and dropped items near you go straight into the pool — tree drops, mining debris, forage, monster loot. Radius 1–32 tiles, feedback can be silent, a sound, or a corner message, and it stays off if you would rather pick things up yourself. Each player chooses their own setting.[/*]
[*][b]Crystalarium re-tooling.[/b] If a copy machine is duplicating something outside the interface's sample list, it is switched to one on the list (can be turned off).[/*]
[*][b]Wireless Access Terminal.[/b] A portable key:
[code]J[/code]opens the terminal,
[code]U[/code]opens crafting,
[code]L[/code]stores your inventory — anywhere.[/*]
[*][b]Vanilla chests.[/b] Hold the wireless terminal and right-click a chest to add it to the network; its contents show up in the terminal alongside the pool.[/*]
[*][b]Shipping.[/b] Alt+click a sample to send that stack from storage to the bin; the bin button opens the vanilla shipping bin so you can take things back before the night sale.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer.[/b] Host-authoritative by design: the pool lives in the host's save, everyone shares one network, and only one player operates an interface at a time. No item duplication.[/*]
[*][b]Fully configurable[/b] through Generic Mod Config Menu (optional). Item descriptions double as tutorials — hover to learn what a block does.[/*]
[*][b]9 languages:[/b] English, Simplified Chinese, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean.[/*]
[/list][b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer (Stardew Valley 1.6+).[/*]
[*]Unzip
[code]AppliedStorage 0.2.3.zip[/code]into your
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Optional but recommended: install Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game settings.[/*]
[*]Start the game and load a save. A welcome letter with a Storage Controller will be in your mailbox; craft more from the crafting menu.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/*]
[/list][b]Nothing is forced on you[/b]
No menus open by themselves, no blocks are placed for you, and every automation switch can be turned off. Want a bigger chest? Use the terminal. Want a factory? Add interfaces.
[b]Feedback[/b]
Found a bug, or want to polish a translation? Comments are very welcome. German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese and Korean are community drafts — corrections are appreciated and credited. The mod is still being updated; some features are still being added.
[line]
中文
[b]应用存储 / Applied Storage[/b]
[i]一个池子，替代一屋子箱子。[/i]
放进去的东西会汇成一份全局存储池，跟着你的存档走 —— 再也不用记煤放在哪个箱子里。终端首先是一块搜索框：输入名字（支持拼音），取出你要的东西，然后回去种地。
[b]功能[/b]
[list]
[*][b]无限共享存储池。[/b] 能堆叠的材料按数字合并；带状态的东西（果酱与它的原料、染色物品、其他模组给物品附加过数据的实例）整份保存，取出来和存进去时一模一样。[/*]
[*][b]存储控制器。[/b] 放在任何地方，它是整个网络的锚点；右键打开终端。[/*]
[*][b]终端。[/b] 按名字或 ID 搜索（中文支持拼音），八个分类标签（全部 / 矿石 / 金属锭 / 材料 / 可食用 / 装饰 / 种子 / 其他），另有取色器。[/*]
[*][b]从存储池合成。[/b] 原版制作页缺料时直接从池里补足，不必翻箱子凑材料。[/*]
[*][b]存储接口。[/b] 贴着机器放，自动从池里投料、回收产物；原版机器与多数模组机器都能用。连通范围 1 / 3 / 5 格（3 和 5 能跨过树与树之间的空隙）。[/*]
[*][b]磁铁模式[/b]（0.2.3 新增）。打开后，你附近掉落的东西会直接进池：砍树掉的、炸矿碎的、采集的、打怪掉的。半径 1–32 格，提示可选静默 / 音效 / 角落文字；只想自己一件件捡就不开。每个玩家各自决定。[/*]
[*][b]宝石复制机换品种。[/b] 复制机正在复制的东西不在接口样本里时，自动换成样本里的品种（可关闭）。[/*]
[*][b]无线访问终端。[/b] 一把随身钥匙：
[code]J[/code]开终端、
[code]U[/code]开合成、
[code]L[/code]一键存背包 —— 在任何地方。[/*]
[*][b]管理原版箱子。[/b] 手持无线终端右键箱子即可纳入网络，箱内物品会和存储池一起显示在终端里。[/*]
[*][b]出货。[/b] Alt+点击样本格，把池里该物品整份送进出货箱；出货箱按钮打开原版出货箱，当晚结算前还能取回来。[/*]
[*][b]多人。[/b] 以房主为权威：存储池存在房主存档里，大家共享同一个网络，同一时间只允许一个人操作界面，不会出现物品复制。[/*]
[*][b]可在 GMCM 里完整配置[/b]（可选）。物品说明本身就是教程，悬停即可读懂。[/*]
[*][b]9 种语言：[/b] 英文、简体中文、德语、法语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、俄语、日语、韩语。[/*]
[/list][b]安装[/b]
[list=1]
[*]安装 SMAPI 4.0.0 或更新版本（对应星露谷物语 1.6+）。[/*]
[*]把
[code]AppliedStorage 0.2.3.zip[/code]解压到
[code]Mods[/code]文件夹。[/*]
[*]可选但推荐：安装 Generic Mod Config Menu，以便在游戏内调整设置。[/*]
[*]启动游戏并读取存档。信箱里会有一封带「应用存储控制器」的慰问信；之后可以在制作页自行打造。[/*]
[/list][b]前置要求[/b]
[list]
[*]星露谷物语 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/*]
[/list][b]它不会强加给你什么[/b]
不会自己弹菜单、不会替你放方块，每一项自动化开关都能关掉。只想要一个大箱子，用终端就够；想做产线，再加接口。
[b]反馈[/b]
发现 bug，或者想把某个语言润色得更地道？非常欢迎在评论区留言。德语、法语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、俄语、日语、韩语目前是社区草稿，修正会一并署名。该模组仍在持续更新，部分功能还在逐步添加。
